peer_identity.arc_label: The Grandmother — from Troglosocialik noble to Metabaronic matriarch
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Merge: OCR alias collision plus old-format duplicate. dona-vicenta is the authoritative 5-record card.
peer_identity.rationale: dona-vicenta (5-record merged card) and dona_vicenta_gabriela_de_rokha are the same character. The fuzzy pair 'do a vicenta' (ratio 0.967) is an OCR artifact of the same alias. dona_vicenta_gabriela_de_rokha uses old underscore format; dona-vicenta is the clean merged canonical. No phase or role split warranted.

aliases: Donna Vicenta Gabriela de Rokha (variant spelling in p15)
appearances: description: Dark-haired woman in military-style clothing and boots. Armed with a hyper-pistol. Later shown in civilian attire in bedroom scenes on Philodendra.; source_refs: ['280_The_Metabarons_11_p02', '297_The_Metabarons_11_p20']
important_actions: Interrupted the investiture ceremony by presenting her father's remains and naming Steelhead as his murderer (p01)
Formally cast a dissenting vote blocking the unanimous requirement for the Medallion of High Nobility (p02)
Drew her hyper-pistol to her own head as a protest suicide threat (p02)
Refused to submit to Steelhead's demand for her vote even under physical coercion (p03–p04)
Woke to Djy-ouk birdsong, investigated her open room and sleeping guards, discovered the Halerce tree restored (p20–p21)
Confronted Melmoth in the golden environment; learned he killed her father; refused forgiveness (p22–p23)
Received the Castaka paleo-revolver from Melmoth at end of volume; outcome deferred (p24)
knowledge_boundaries: Did not know Melmoth's identity when she first found herself attracted to him in the golden environment (p22–p23)
Does not know who put her guards to sleep at the start of p20
relationships: target: Don Nicanor Rosamel de Rokha; nature: Her father; President of the Troglosocialik Confederation; murdered by Steelhead before the investiture ceremony; she presents his remains as evidence; source_refs: ['279_The_Metabarons_11_p01', '282_The_Metabarons_11_p04']

target: Steelhead / Melmoth; nature: He murdered her father; physically overpowered her; she blocked his ceremony; later develops feelings for him as Melmoth before learning his identity; declares she loves and hates him most; source_refs: ['280_The_Metabarons_11_p02', '300_The_Metabarons_11_p23', '301_The_Metabarons_11_p24']
target: The Empire / The Empress; nature: Imperial Purple Endoguards have been stationed around her, implying imperial protection or surveillance; source_refs: ['297_The_Metabarons_11_p20']
target: Metabaron lineage; nature: Claims clan membership or descent; invokes it as authority at the ceremony; source_refs: ['280_The_Metabarons_11_p02']
traits: Forceful and principled — interrupts a major public ceremony alone
Willing to die publicly rather than endorse a corrupt ceremony
Identifies herself as a member or descendant of the Metabaron lineage
Refuses to submit even when physically overpowered
Emotionally conflicted — loves and hates Melmoth simultaneously
Alert and investigative — immediately notices birdsong, open doors, sleeping guards
Refuses to accept the Halerce tree's return as compensation for her father's murder
voice_notes: Accuses Steelhead of destroying the 250,000-year-old Halerce tree and exterminating five million Dyukka-birds (p02)
Invokes Metabaron lineage: 'a Metabaron is part of a lineage that will continue after her death' (p02)
To Melmoth: 'I love you most and hate you most' (p23–p24)

witnessed_facts: Her father's remains — a skull or bone fragments — were presented by her at the investiture ceremony as evidence of murder (p01)
Steelhead physically threw her aside before a large public crowd (p03–p04)
The site of the Halerce tree on Philodendra was a scorched hole the day before Melmoth restored it (p21)
Her Imperial Endoguards were rendered unconscious by an unknown actor (p20)

Named in the next-episode teaser: 'The Torment of Dona Vicenta' [333_The_Metabarons_12_p24]
